pages.text: $(l)Reiko's Train Mod$() adds big trains, two blocks wide and three tall, on their own track: steam engines, a diesel, an electric, the Bullet Train and trams, with coaches and wagons for everything.$(br2)Signal the line, name its stations, and drive the trains yourself or let a timetable run them.
A tank engine and its coaches at the station.

This book has a chapter for each part of the mod. Start with $(l:getting_started/first_train)Your First Train$(/l), then look things up as you need them.$(br2)The mod's screens have a little book button in their corner: it opens this book at their page.
Lost this book? Make another from a book and a piece of Train Track.
